summary: Frontend-only verification of the i18n gap-closure round (21 new keys + hardcoded strings wrapped) on the LIVE account hostbay@moxx.co. Switched account UI language to French via /settings?section=profile (MUI language select), verified all target strings, then RESTORED language to 'en' and confirmed via API (GET /api/user/profile -> language='en'). Results: Settings scope chip translated for both account-scoped (profile/notifications -> "S'applique à l'ensemble de votre compte") and company-scoped (company/payments/tax -> "S'applique à hostbay") sections; Dashboard subline = 'vs période précédente · 15 paiements' (and 86/278/409 for 30D/90D/1Y); range eyebrow (data-testid=dash2026-chart-eyebrow) = 'Volume · 7 jours' / '30 jours' / '90 jours' / '12 mois'; quick-action shortcut = 'Liens de paiement' (no English 'Payment links' anywhere on dashboard); Storefront->Page theme chip = "S'applique uniquement à cette entreprise". No raw i18n key leaks on Dashboard, Settings, Transactions or Storefront; zero console errors on all pages. Static catalog audit (new script /app/tests/check_i18n_keys_iter72.py) confirms all 21 keys exist in all 6 locales with correct placeholder style ({count}/{range} single-brace for .replace(), {{count}}/{{company}} for i18next).

issues: Remaining untranslated English strings alongside the newly-translated scope chip: page title 'Storefront', subtitle 'Your Dynopay page — tips, products and payment links behind one link.', 'Editing hostbay's storefront', tabs 'Page/Products/Share', 'Your public page', 'Page theme' + its description, 'Accent button', 'ACCENT COLOR', 'COVER STYLE', preview 'Support me' / 'Your payment links appear here'. Out of scope of this round but the next obvious i18n gap.

action_items: No fixes required for this round — all 6 requested items pass (5 verified in-browser, 1 not exercisable).
Optional follow-up: translate remaining hardcoded English strings on the Storefront page (title/subtitle/tabs/Page-theme labels) — see design_issues.
critical_code_review_comments: VolumeHero.tsx (dash2026-hero-rangelabel) is not rendered in the current v2026 dashboard layout; the visible range eyebrow comes from VolumeChart.tsx (data-testid=dash2026-chart-eyebrow). Same t('volumeOver') key, so behaviour is correct, but the review request's expected testid does not exist on screen — consider removing the dead VolumeHero eyebrow path or aligning testids.

periodVsPrevious/volumeOver intentionally use single-brace placeholders consumed by .replace(); this diverges from i18next interpolation used elsewhere (taxAcross_one/_other, settingsPage.scopeCompany). Verified consistent across all 6 locales, but it is fragile for future translators — a lint/CI check on placeholder style is advisable (script added at /app/tests/check_i18n_keys_iter72.py can serve that purpose).
seed_data_creation: None. No data mutated on the LIVE account other than the account language field, which was set to 'fr' for testing and restored to 'en' (verified via GET /api/user/profile).
